name: already-good-control
prompt: Lightly proofread this paragraph for a small literary magazine. Change only actual errors; preserve every intentional stylistic choice, and return the paragraph without commentary. 'By six, the garden had gone blue. My father kept digging—slowly, as if the potatoes might object. We ate late; nobody mentioned the clock.'
expected_output: The paragraph returned unchanged because it has no actual errors.
assertions: Returns exactly the paragraph without surrounding quotation marks or commentary.
